title: Shared Calendar Conflict with Family Events
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sharedcalendar:event
| stats count(eval(conflict="true")) as conflicts count as events by event_type
| sort 0 - conflicts
description: Ranks event typess by calendar conflicts.
value: Conflict counts help show which kinds of commitments are crowding out time together the most.
implementation: Send calendar conflicts events to `index=personal` and keep `event_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of calendar conflicts by event types.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which event typess stand out most for calendar conflicts.
